manifesto.title: About
manifesto.hook: I build systems, and I make sure they run flawlessly.
manifesto.narrative: Currently a Data Quality Assurance Specialist for a Tier-1 global Autonomous Driving project. This role demands absolute precision, zero-defect tolerance, and rigorous consistency across complex 3D spatial data. Before diving into AI data infrastructure, I built my logical foundation through full-stack web engineering. My experience as an Internal Audit Administrator gave me a macro perspective on business processes, while my role as a Teaching Talent honed my technical communication skills.
manifesto.valueProposition: I combine an engineer's logic, an auditor's sharp eye, and the rigorous quality standards required for modern AI.

jobs.description: Managed data integrity for a Tier-1 global autonomous driving AI model. Audited complex 3D point cloud segmentation (Semantic OCC) and prevented temporal tracking failures (ID-Switches) across thousands of dynamic objects in 360° multi-camera views (ODN).
